description: Illustrative Hong Kong adult profiles for early product exploration. Segment weights and all traits below are authored assumptions, not population estimates.

segments.name: Busy working adults
authored_assumptions: Illustrative working-adult segment; weight is an authored assumption.
Household routines, technology comfort and price sensitivity are invented exploration traits, not measured facts.

segments.name: Household organisers
authored_assumptions: Illustrative household-organiser segment; weight is an authored assumption.
Convenience and refill interest are hypotheses to explore, not evidence of demand.

segments.name: Budget-conscious young adults
authored_assumptions: Illustrative young-adult segment; weight is an authored assumption.
Budget sensitivity and sustainable-product interest are invented persona traits.

segments.name: Careful digital adopters
authored_assumptions: Illustrative careful-adopter segment; weight is an authored assumption.
Technology comfort is sampled independently; age does not establish an individual's digital ability.
